source.quote: SMSL's own page for the D12, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « The latest XMOS XU-316 solution supports sampling rate up to 32bit/768KHz and DSD512 ; »; « One pieces of AKM's new AK4493S chip, and carefully adjusted it to an unprecedented 0.00015% ; »

facts.chip: AKM AK4493S (« One pieces of AKM's new AK4493S chip »), XMOS XU-316 on USB.

_the_ceiling_is_the_XMOS_bullet: The rate and DSD ceilings come from the bullet naming the XMOS USB receiver, so they are written on usb only. No other input is given a PCM rate: the page states none.
_USB_only: No input but USB is named. Whether DSD512 is native or DoP is not said.
